title: Tamely ramified setting: Yu / Kim–Yu / AFMO datum
body_html:
Tamely ramified setting

A generic cuspidal datum (Yu) is a 5-tuple $(\vec G, (x, \{\iota\}), \vec r, \rho, \vec \phi)$ where:

  1. $\vec G = (G^0, \dots, G^n = G)$ is a sequence of tamely ramified twisted Levi subgroups with $Z(G^0) / Z(G)$ anisotropic.
  2. $x \in \mathcal{B}^0 := \mathcal{B}(G^0)$ is a point in the extended Bruhat–Tits building of $G^0$, with image $[x]$ in the reduced building; $\{\iota\}$ is a family of compatible admissible embeddings of buildings $\mathcal{B}^0 \hookrightarrow \mathcal{B}^1 \hookrightarrow \cdots \hookrightarrow \mathcal{B}^n$.
  3. $\vec r = (r_0, \dots, r_n)$, $0 < r_0 < \cdots < r_{n-1} \le r_n$ (with $r_0 \ge 0$ if $n = 0$).
  4. $\rho$ is an irreducible $G^0_{[x]}$-representation with $\rho|_{G^0_{x, 0+}}$ being $\mathbf 1$-isotypic and $\rho|_{G^0_{x, 0}}$ containing an inflation of a cuspidal representation of $G^0_{x, 0} / G^0_{x, 0+}$, and such that $\cInd_{G^0_{[x]}}^{G^0} \rho$ is irreducible.
  5. $\vec \phi = (\phi_0, \dots, \phi_n)$ a sequence of characters $\phi_i : G^i \to R^\times$ of depth $r_i$, $G^{i+1}$-generic at $x$ in Yu's sense for $i < n$.

Heisenberg–Weil datum [AFMO2 §3.6]

The positive-depth part of a generic cuspidal datum is encapsulated in a Heisenberg–Weil datum $(\vec G, (x, \{\iota\}), \vec r, K_x^0, \vec \phi)$ with $n \ge 1$ and $K_x^0$ an open subgroup of $G^0_{[x]}$.

For our purposes set $M := G^0$, $\mathcal{B}(M) := \mathcal{B}(G^0)$. A (partial) Heisenberg–Weil datum $\Sigma := (\vec G, \vec r, \vec \phi)$ gives rise to: $$K_{x,+} = G^{(0)}_{x, 0+} G^{(1)}_{x, r_0/2+} \cdots, \quad K_{x,0+} = G^{(0)}_{x, 0+} G^{(1)}_{x, r_0/2} \cdots, \quad J_x = G^{(1)}_{x, r_0/2} \cdots, \quad K_x = G^{(0)}_{x, 0} J_x.$$

These give the $\mathscr{K}$-cosheaf for the §5 generalized building machinery (see [[node:applications.tame_K_F_construction]]).
